AUTHORED FIGURE BRIEF:
This figure is part of a worked example that evaluates the line integral of F = cos(x) i + sin(x) j along two different oriented curves. The figure contains two panels (a) and (b), each showing the same vector field F drawn over a green-shaded background with the note Vectors not to scale. Panel (a): the oriented curve C is a short vertical red line segment at x = -pi/2, directed downards from y = 2 to y = 1. Panel (b): the oriented curve C is a parabolic arc from (-1, 1) to (2, 4), directed first down, then upward and to the right. The figure shows the two distinct integration paths for parts (a) and (b) of the example, making visible how each curve's geometry and alignment relative to the field vectors determines the computed line integral. Note that the two parts of the image are differently scaled.

REQUESTED INTERACTIONS:
- Drag the endpoints of curve C to reshape the integration path through the vector field and watch the line integral value update in real time
- Toggle between the two panels (short vertical path vs. long curved path) to compare how path shape and length affect the line integral value over the same field
- Slider for parameter t: animate a moving point along C and display the field vector and its dot product with the tangent at each step

SOURCE FILE: Anton, Bivens, and Davis. Calculus, 10th Edition, Figure 15.2.12

There is no blueprint: decide the figure type, elements, labels, controls, and any step sequence yourself.

var sy = r.y + r.h - (pt.y - panel.yDomain[0]) / (panel.yDomain[1] - panel.yDomain[0]) * r.h; return { x: sx, y: sy }; } function screenToWorld(panel, pt) { var r = panel.rect; var x = panel.xDomain[0] + (pt.x - r.x) / r.w * (panel.xDomain[1] - panel.xDomain[0]); 'italic' : 'normal', anchor: anchor || 'middle' }) .fill(COLORS.ink) .move(x, y); } function drawFractionMinusPiOver2(panel) { var p = worldToScreen(panel, { x: -Math.PI / 2, y: 0 }); var y0 = worldToScreen(panel, { x: 0, y: 0 }).y; addText(labelG, '−π', p.x - 12, y0 + 34, 34, false, 'middle'); labelG.line(p.x - 43, y0 + 65, p.x + 16, y0 + 65).stroke({ color: COLORS.ink, width: 1.7 }); addText(labelG, '2', p.x - 12, y0 + 65, 34, false, 'middle'); } function drawAxes(panel) { var r = panel.rect; var y0 = worldToScreen(panel, { x: 0, y: 0 }).y; var x0 = worldToScreen(panel, { x: 0, y: 0 }).x; arrow(staticG, r.x - 25, y0, r.x + r.w + 44, y0, COLORS.ink, 2.5, 23, 23, 1); arrow(staticG, x0, r.y + r.h + 25, x0, r.y - 45, COLORS.ink, 2.5, 23, 23, 1); addText(labelG, 'x', r.x + r.w + 36, y0 - 36, 34, true, 'middle'); addText(labelG, 'y', x0 + 31, r.y - 45, 34, true, 'middle'); var tickLen = 14; function tickX(x, lab) { var p = worldToScreen(panel, { x: x, y: 0 }); staticG.line(p.x, y0 - tickLen, p.x, y0 + tickLen).stroke({ color: COLORS.ink, width: 2 }); if (lab) addText(labelG, lab, p.x, y0 + 18, 32, false, 'middle'); } function tickY(y, lab) { var p = worldToScreen(panel, { x: 0, y: y }); staticG.line(x0 - tickLen, p.y, x0 + tickLen, p.y).stroke({ color: COLORS.ink, width: 2 }); if (lab) addText(labelG, lab, x0 - 28, p.y - 20, 32, false, 'middle'); } if (panel.key === 'a') { tickX(-Math.PI / 2, ''); tickY(1, '1'); tickY(2, '2'); drawFractionMinusPiOver2(panel); } else { [-2, -1, 1, 2, 3].forEach(function (x) { tickX(x, String(x).replace('-', '−')); }); [1, 2, 3, 4].forEach(function (y) { tickY(y, String(y)); }); } } function drawVectorField(panel) { var cols = panel.key === 'a' ? 12 : 13; var rows = panel.key === 'a' ? 10 : 13; var len = panel.key === 'a' ? 31 : 28; var xmin = panel.xDomain[0] + 0.15, xmax = panel.xDomain[1] - 0.15; var ymin = panel.yDomain[0] + 0.18, ymax = panel.yDomain[1] - 0.18; for (var i = 0; i < cols; i++) { var x = xmin + (xmax - xmin) * i / (cols - 1); var f = fieldAt(x); var sv = screenScaleVector(panel, f.x, f.y); var mag = Math.sqrt(sv.x * sv.x + sv.y * sv.y) || 1; var ux = sv.x / mag, uy = sv.y / mag; for (var j = 0; j < rows; j++) { var y = ymin + (ymax - ymin) * j / (rows - 1); var c = worldToScreen(panel, { x: x, y: y }); var a = arrow(staticG, c.x - ux * len / 2, c.y - uy * len / 2, c.x + ux * len / 2, c.y + uy * len / 2, COLORS.ink, 2, 8, 8, 1); if (a) { a.css('cursor', 'pointer'); a.on('mousemove', function (e) { showTooltip('Vector field F = cos(x)i + sin(x)j. All arrows are normalized, so direction matters more than drawn length.', e); }); a.on('mouseleave', function () { hideTooltip(); }); } } } } function curveControl(panel) { var dx = panel.p1.x - panel.p0.x; var sag = Math.max(0.8, Math.abs(dx)); return { x: (panel.p0.x + panel.p1.x) / 2, y: Math.min(panel.p0.y, panel.p1.y) - sag }; } function pointOnCurve(panel, t) { if (panel.kind === 'line') { return { x: panel.p0.x + (panel.p1.x - panel.p0.x) * t, y: panel.p0.y + (panel.p1.y - panel.p0.y) * t }; } var c = curveControl(panel); var u = 1 - t; return { x: u * u * panel.p0.x + 2 * u * t * c.x + t * t * panel.p1.x, y: u * u * panel.p0.y + 2 * u * t * c.y + t * t * panel.p1.y }; } function tangentOnCurve(panel, t) { if (panel.kind === 'line') { return { x: panel.p1.x - panel.p0.x, y: panel.p1.y - panel.p0.y }; } var c = curveControl(panel); return { x: 2 * (1 - t) * (c.x - panel.p0.x) + 2 * t * (panel.p1.x - c.x), y: 2 * (1 - t) * (c.y - panel.p0.y) + 2 * t * (panel.p1.y - c.y) }; } function integrand(panel, t) { var p = pointOnCurve(panel, t); var d = tangentOnCurve(panel, t); var f = fieldAt(p.x); return f.x * d.x + f.y * d.y; } function integral(panel) { return integrateSimpson(function (u) { return integrand(panel, u); }, 0, 1, 500); } function sampledPath(panel, n) { var pts = []; for (var i = 0; i <= n; i++) { var p = pointOnCurve(panel, i / n); var s = worldToScreen(panel, p); pts.push([s.x, s.y]); } return pts; } function drawHandle(g, panel, which, pt) { var s = worldToScreen(panel, pt); var ringColor = panel.key === activePanel ? The dot product compares this direction with F.', e); }) .on('mouseleave', function () { hideTooltip(); }); g.circle(8).center(s.x, s.y).fill(COLORS.white).stroke({ color: COLORS.red, width: 2 }); } function renderStatic() { staticG.clear(); labelG.clear(); addPlainText(labelG, 'Vectors not to scale', W / 2, 0, 43, true, 'middle'); Object.keys(panels).forEach(function (k) { var panel = panels[k]; var r = panel.rect; staticG.rect(r.w, r.h).move(r.x, r.y).fill(COLORS.bg).stroke('none'); drawVectorField(panel); drawAxes(panel); addText(labelG, panel.label, r.x + r.w / 2, r.y + r.h + 55, 42, true, 'middle'); }); } function renderDynamic() { dynG.clear(); drawCurve(panels.a); drawCurve(panels.b); updateReadouts(); } function updateReadouts() { var panel = panels[activePanel]; var I = integral(panel); var dot = integrand(panel, tValue); document.getElementById('activeVal').value = activePanel === 'a' ? '(a)' : '(b)'; document.getElementById('intVal').value = I.toFixed(3); document.getElementById('dotVal').value = dot.toFixed(3); } function update_t(v) { tValue = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v)); renderDynamic(); } function toggle_panel(on) { activePanel = on ? 'b' : 'a'; renderDynamic(); } function trigger_reset() { Object.keys(panels).forEach(function (k) { panels[k].p0 = { x: panels[k].defaults.p0.x, y: panels[k].defaults.p0.y }; panels[k].p1 = { x: panels[k].defaults.p1.x, y: panels[k].defaults.p1.y }; }); tValue = 0.5; document.getElementById('tInput').value = '0.50'; document.getElementById('tVal').value = '0.50'; renderDynamic(); } function clientToSvgPoint(e) { var pt = draw.node.createSVGPoint(); pt.x = e.clientX; pt.y = e.clientY; return pt.matrixTransform(draw.node.getScreenCTM().inverse()); } document.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) { if (!dragging) return; var sp = clientToSvgPoint(e); var wp = screenToWorld(dragging.panel, sp); dragging.panel[dragging.which] = wp; renderDynamic(); }); document.addEventListener('pointerup', function () { dragging = null; }); renderStatic(); renderDynamic(); window.__markRendered(); // @FIGURE_CODE_END
